dict.Un rând pe fiecare anunț: prețul, supraf: One row per listing: the price, the usable area and, if you like, the monthly costs (building fees, heating) and the commute.
dict.Nota ta (1–10) e părerea ta după poze sa: Your rating (1–10) is your opinion after the photos or the viewing; the score weighs it together with the price per sq m and the commute.
dict.Cu bugetul scris sus, anunțurile mai scu: With your budget filled in above, more expensive listings show "Over budget" (in red). For rentals, enter the monthly rent as the Price.
dict.Pentru cine cumpără sau închiriază o loc: For anyone buying or renting a home: each listing with the price, area, rooms, floor, monthly costs and commute; you get the price per sq m, a score from your rating, the price per sq m and the commute, and the status: best (in green), over budget (in red), to visit (in yellow) or visited; on the right the average price and the cheapest per sq m.
